contract.mailbox_payload_stability: source holds transaction/frame/bank/payload until matching synchronized ack
contract.publish_payload: frame/object payload is frozen at source EOF publication; SOF payload is capture metadata/default only
contract.ack_point: destination explicit RAM-last-read; ack arrival releases only the source bank while the copied task may remain in HOG/SVM
contract.busy_destination_mailbox: one synchronized request remains visible and stable while the old copied task finishes; it is accepted immediately when the executor becomes idle
contract.algorithm_done: may occur only after RAM-last-read and creates display CDC update
contract.busy_policy: a free second bank may capture while one task is outstanding; if matching ack has not arrived by EOF, that whole captured frame is discarded instead of queued
contract.duplicate_policy: duplicates whose full identity differs are counted and ignored; finite-width full-tuple wrap cannot distinguish an arbitrarily delayed old ack
contract.reset: coordinated reset clears banks, mailboxes, destination task, queued CDC events and display tables
contract.identity_width_status: Python nominal values only; arch_lead must freeze RTL widths from frame rate and maximum stale-message lifetime
contract.frame_wrap: frame IDs compare modulo 16; transaction identity remains independent until the complete identity tuple aliases
contract.bank_generation: each round-robin bank allocation increments its own generation modulo 4294967296; transaction/frame/bank/generation all participate in ack matching
contract.wrap_safety_requirement: the maximum lifetime of any synchronized request/ack must be strictly shorter than the minimum full-identity alias interval; use a level/toggle handshake plus coordinated reset flushing, and prove this bound before RTL
contract.HDMI: CDC result writes pending; the latest completed snapshot before the modeled VSYNC boundary event wins; VSYNC atomically replaces active, records both display/source frame IDs plus frame_id_modulo_delta, and active is frozen until another VSYNC; the delta is not latency unless the two counters share a measured epoch/cadence; RTL must freeze the physical VSYNC edge/polarity
